editorNote: A quieter Saturday: space stocks and gold slid, bitcoin news turned to a possible corporate sale and a new ETF launch, and Apple set a testing date for its Alibaba tie-up. Article bodies were not retrievable, so details are limited to what the linked outlets' headlines state.

stories.headline: Apple says Alibaba's Qwen-powered Apple Intelligence in China opens for testing on November 4, per a Futu report
stories.summary: A Futu Niuniu headline says Apple has officially announced that its intelligent access to Alibaba's Qwen will open for testing on November 4. The article body could not be retrieved.
stories.whyItMatters: If the headline is accurate, it sets a date for a testing phase of the Apple–Alibaba AI tie-up.
